warnings: Axes: x = grids 1, 2, 3 (3.60 + 1.80); y = Thai rows printed top-to-bottom ก, ข, ค, ง (3.00 + 2.10 + 1.90). Origin = ก1.

Three levels share the printed label 'ระดับหลังอะเส' (+3.80, +4.20, +5.10 on A-06): main gable-roof wall plate plus the two ends of the lean-to roof over rows ข–ค. All three kept under the printed label.

Level conflicts recorded, not resolved: A-06 รูปตัด ข tags the rooms 'เอนกประสงค์ +0.90' and 'เตรียมอาหาร +0.90' while the same sheet's level line and S-02's room tags give +1.80; the stilt house's floor is at +1.80/+2.10 per every chain, so +0.90 looks like a drafting slip, but it is printed and kept.
y 6.10 (roof eave, ค'') and 6.15 (stair slab edge, ค''') are 0.05 apart but are genuinely different edges (roof vs ground slab) — kept as two lines.
x 3.50 (1'''') is the timber deck's outer edge, 0.10 short of grid 2 — not merged with grid 2.
Sheets dimension-swept: S-01, S-02, A-06. Not swept (outside op04 scope, nothing structural): A-01..A-05, A-07 stair, A-08 toilet, E-01, SN-01 — recorded honestly rather than claiming a full sweep.
